create.name: Cam Cooney
create.bio:
Cam Cooney is an Australian-born teacher of Vedic meditation who has made his home in Glasgow, where he runs a small meditation studio in Kinning Park. He went to his first beginners' class in 2013, spent the following years trying many styles on courses and retreats in several countries, and qualified as a Vedic meditation teacher in 2019 after a long residential training of some three and a half months of intensive practice.

He teaches a simple mantra-based technique practised sitting comfortably in a chair, and presents it without robes, jargon or the need for any belief. Newcomers start with a free introductory session, then learn the full method over a seven-part course that moves from the practical mechanics to the wider spiritual picture of consciousness. Students can also learn one to one, keep going through live weekly group sits on his own app, and join occasional residential retreats in the west of Scotland. His larger events have included guided meditations under the dome of the Glasgow Planetarium. Outside teaching he is a Movember ambassador and has taken on a number of charity challenges, including a long meditation sit and five nights sleeping rough in Glasgow to raise money for a homelessness charity.

courses.title: Learn To Meditate: 7 Day Course
courses.description: His foundation course in Vedic meditation, taken in seven sessions of about an hour through his app. It moves from guided practice to sitting with a personal mantra on your own, then covers the Western science of rest and the Eastern view of consciousness.
courses.price: Included in app membership (from £99 GBP a year; lifetime £399 GBP)

courses.title: Meditate With Cam: live weekly classes and app
courses.description: A membership app with a live group meditation every week, recordings of past classes, an on-demand library, short courses and immersive soundscape tracks. A free seven-day trial is offered before choosing a plan.
courses.price: £9 GBP a month, £99 GBP a year or £399 GBP lifetime

courses.title: Learning Privately: one-to-one Vedic meditation
courses.description: The technique taught one to one over three sessions, starting with a personal mantra and ending with the spiritual side of practice, followed by a catch-up within a month. It also gives access to his weekly classes and retreats.

free_resources.title: Your First Session
free_resources.description: A free introductory class in Vedic meditation, either inside his app or as a short online meeting with Cam, explaining where the technique comes from and how it is learned.
